description: This shell script is a test script for verifying the usage of 'git svn' with the 'useSvmProps' configuration. It loads a Subversion repository dump, initializes several 'git svn' remotes with minimized URLs, sets the 'svn.useSvmProps' configuration to true, fetches all remotes, and then performs a series of verification steps to check the commit metadata for different svn branches and revisions. It also includes tests for finding revisions based on SVN revision numbers and performing an empty rebase.
